Produk ini memberi penyewa maupun pemilik rumah cara sederhana untuk menambah pembangkit energi terdistribusi tanpa memerlukan array atap penuh.
translations.metaDescription: Spesifikasi, RFQ, dan detail procurement untuk kit pemasangan surya balkon 430W Skyworth Wall Mounting.

features: M10 wafer platform spanning the 420-645W power range
Mid-format panel size for rooftop and mixed-scale projects
Standardized documentation for repeatable procurement review

translations.name: Skyworth M10 Series
translations.shortDescription: Mono PV module series in the 420-645W power range on M10 wafer format.
translations.description: The M10 Series covers Skyworth's 420-645W module lineup built on the M10 wafer platform, balancing panel size and power output for rooftop and mixed-scale solar projects. It gives procurement teams a mid-format option between compact rooftop modules and the largest utility-scale panels.
translations.metaDescription: Specs, RFQ, and procurement details for the Skyworth M10 Series solar module lineup (420-645W).

translations.name: Skyworth M10 Series
translations.shortDescription: Seri modul PV mono pada rentang daya 420-645W dengan format wafer M10.
translations.description: M10 Series mencakup jajaran modul Skyworth pada rentang daya 420-645W yang dibangun di atas platform wafer M10, menyeimbangkan ukuran panel dan output daya untuk proyek surya rooftop maupun skala campuran. Seri ini memberi tim procurement pilihan format menengah antara modul rooftop yang ringkas dan panel utility-scale terbesar.
translations.metaDescription: Spesifikasi, RFQ, dan detail procurement untuk jajaran modul surya Skyworth M10 Series (420-645W).

features: Large-format G12 wafer platform spanning the 630-720W power range
Higher per-panel output for utility and large commercial arrays
Fewer panels per megawatt to simplify racking and installation labor

translations.name: Skyworth G12 Series
translations.shortDescription: Mono PV module series in the 630-720W power range on G12 wafer format.
translations.description: The G12 Series is Skyworth's large-format module lineup in the 630-720W power range, built on G12 wafer cells to push per-panel output higher for utility and large commercial arrays. Fewer panels per megawatt can simplify racking, wiring, and installation labor on bigger projects.
translations.metaDescription: Specs, RFQ, and procurement details for the Skyworth G12 Series solar module lineup (630-720W).

translations.name: Skyworth G12 Series
translations.shortDescription: Seri modul PV mono pada rentang daya 630-720W dengan format wafer G12.
translations.description: G12 Series adalah jajaran modul format besar Skyworth pada rentang daya 630-720W, dibangun dengan sel wafer G12 untuk mendorong output per panel lebih tinggi bagi array utility dan komersial berskala besar. Jumlah panel yang lebih sedikit per megawatt dapat menyederhanakan racking, pengkabelan, dan tenaga kerja pemasangan pada proyek besar.
translations.metaDescription: Spesifikasi, RFQ, dan detail procurement untuk jajaran modul surya Skyworth G12 Series (630-720W).

features: Rectangular G12R wafer platform spanning the 440-630W power range
Panel footprint suited to both rooftop and ground-mount layouts
Positioned between the M10 and G12 series on size and power

translations.name: Skyworth G12R Series
translations.shortDescription: Mono PV module series in the 440-630W power range on G12R wafer format.
translations.description: The G12R Series uses a rectangular G12R wafer format to fit the 440-630W power range into a panel footprint suited to both rooftop and ground-mount layouts. It sits between the M10 and G12 series, giving procurement teams a middle ground on panel dimensions, weight, and per-unit power.
translations.metaDescription: Specs, RFQ, and procurement details for the Skyworth G12R Series solar module lineup (440-630W).

translations.name: Skyworth G12R Series
translations.shortDescription: Seri modul PV mono pada rentang daya 440-630W dengan format wafer G12R.
translations.description: G12R Series menggunakan format wafer persegi panjang G12R untuk menghadirkan rentang daya 440-630W dalam footprint panel yang cocok untuk tata letak rooftop maupun ground-mount. Seri ini berada di antara M10 dan G12 Series, memberi tim procurement titik tengah dalam dimensi panel, bobot, dan daya per unit.
translations.metaDescription: Spesifikasi, RFQ, dan detail procurement untuk jajaran modul surya Skyworth G12R Series (440-630W).

features: Stainless steel construction for corrosion resistance
Adjustable base plate with multiple mounting holes
Built for tile-roof rafter alignment flexibility

translations.name: For Tile Roof
translations.shortDescription: Stainless steel roof hook for tile-roof solar mounting.
translations.description: The For Tile Roof mounting hook is a stainless steel bracket for tile-roof solar installations, featuring an adjustable base plate with multiple mounting holes for flexible rafter alignment. It is built for installers who need a dependable, corrosion-resistant anchor point across varied tile roof profiles.
translations.metaDescription: Specs, RFQ, and procurement details for the Skyworth For Tile Roof solar mounting hardware.

translations.name: For Tile Roof
translations.shortDescription: Roof hook stainless steel untuk pemasangan surya di atap genteng.
translations.description: Roof hook For Tile Roof adalah braket stainless steel untuk instalasi surya di atap genteng, dengan base plate yang dapat disetel dan memiliki banyak lubang pemasangan untuk fleksibilitas penyelarasan pada kaso atap. Produk ini dibuat untuk instalatur yang membutuhkan titik jangkar tahan korosi yang andal pada berbagai profil atap genteng.
translations.metaDescription: Spesifikasi, RFQ, dan detail procurement untuk perangkat mounting Skyworth For Tile Roof.

features: Waterproof bracket with sealed roof penetration
Adjustable L-foot for height and angle alignment
Designed for slate and metal roof PV installations

translations.name: For Slate Roof
translations.shortDescription: Waterproof mounting bracket with adjustable L-foot for slate-roof solar installations.
translations.description: The For Slate Roof mounting bracket is a waterproof solar roof bracket with a base plate and adjustable L-foot, designed for slate and metal roof photovoltaic installations. It keeps the roof penetration sealed while giving installers height and angle adjustment during array alignment.
translations.metaDescription: Specs, RFQ, and procurement details for the Skyworth For Slate Roof solar mounting hardware.

translations.name: For Slate Roof
translations.shortDescription: Braket pemasangan waterproof dengan L-foot yang dapat disetel untuk instalasi surya atap slate.
translations.description: Braket For Slate Roof adalah braket atap surya waterproof dengan base plate dan L-foot yang dapat disetel, dirancang untuk instalasi fotovoltaik pada atap slate maupun metal. Produk ini menjaga titik penetrasi atap tetap kedap air sambil memberi instalatur penyesuaian tinggi dan sudut saat penyelarasan array.
translations.metaDescription: Spesifikasi, RFQ, dan detail procurement untuk perangkat mounting Skyworth For Slate Roof.
